categories.name: Synthesizers
categories.blurb: Full-bodied polyphonic Voice Cells for chords, stabs and keys: patch Notes in and take Out L/R.

categories.name: Basses
categories.blurb: Mono and legato Voice Cells for low lines: patch Notes in and take Out L/R.

categories.name: Leads
categories.blurb: Monophonic and few-voice Voice Cells for melodies and solos, from brass swells and glass partials to ring-mod, vowel, bowed and heterodyne voices: patch Notes in and Out L/R out.

categories.name: Pads
categories.blurb: Slow, moving polyphonic Voice Cells for chords and beds, from additive and wavetable clouds to formant choirs, breath organs and folded textures: patch Notes in and Out L/R out.

categories.name: Plucks & Mallets
categories.blurb: Struck, plucked and pinged Voice Cells (physical models, mallets, strings and bells) that follow velocity: patch Notes in and Out L/R out.

categories.name: Samples
categories.blurb: Cells that play recorded sounds: slicers, sample instruments and granular textures.

categories.name: Feedback & Pings
categories.blurb: Lab-bench pings and feedback loops: a click or noise burst rings a tuned resonance (a self-oscillating filter, comb, resonator, test oscillator, delay loop) and the note tunes it. Voice Cells that follow velocity: patch Notes in and Out L/R out.

categories.name: Drum Machines
categories.blurb: Whole kits that play by themselves with the transport: patch Out L/R to the output.

categories.name: Drums/Kicks
categories.blurb: One-shot bass drums, from soft thuds to layered club kicks: patch a trigger into Trig.

categories.name: Drums/Snares & Claps
categories.blurb: One-shot snares and handclaps, from brushed to gated: patch a trigger into Trig.

categories.name: Drums/Hats & Cymbals
categories.blurb: Hi-hats with Closed and Open triggers, shakers, and crash, ride and gong cymbals.

categories.name: Drums/Toms & Percussion
categories.blurb: Toms, hand drums and small percussion: patch a trigger into Trig.

categories.name: Drums/FX
categories.blurb: Pings, chirps, glass, gongs and noise hits for fills and transitions.

categories.name: Sequencers
categories.blurb: Note sources that follow the transport: patch Notes into any Voice Cell.

categories.name: Effects
categories.blurb: Space, time and movement: reverbs, delays, choruses, phasers, shimmer and textures. Patch In L/R from any sound and take Out L/R onwards.

categories.name: Processing
categories.blurb: Dynamics, stereo, spectral and character effects: tremolo and rotary movement, mid-side and band splits, gates and ducking, tape slowdown and worn-record degradation.

categories.name: Processors
categories.blurb: Tone-shaping and dynamics: EQ, compression, saturation, filters, gating, widening and distortion for any stereo signal.

categories.name: Modulators
categories.blurb: Control, gate and trigger sources for everything else on the board: LFOs, randomness, envelopes and rhythms.

categories.name: Generative
categories.blurb: Self-playing patches: press play and they make music on their own, in time with the transport. Out L/R out.

categories.name: Ambient Drones
categories.blurb: Long, sustained beds that move by themselves: nothing to play, no transport needed. Out L/R out.

categories.name: Ambient Textures
categories.blurb: Noise, grains and resonances that evolve slowly: weather and rooms rather than notes. Nothing to play, no transport needed. Out L/R out.

categories.name: Ambient Melodies
categories.blurb: Slow generative notes held to a scale: sparse, ringing and never the same twice. Nothing to play, no transport needed. Out L/R out.

categories.name: Starters
categories.blurb: Empty cells to start your own instrument or effect from.

categories.name: Test
categories.blurb: Presets for trying things out by hand in a host.

preset.description: A saw and a narrow pulse through a ladder that snaps open and shuts again: short, punchy chord stabs, swirled by a phaser and set in a room. Play it with a shared Cutoff knob.

help.text:
A Dual Osc supplies a saw (A) and a narrow pulse (B) an octave apart. A quick Filter Env opens a Ladder Tanh filter on each key and lets it fall back to a closed 500 Hz, so every chord is a short stab. The summed voices then pass through a slow Phaser and a short Reverb, so the stabs have movement and a room to ring in.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter's resting point; turn it up for bright, open stabs.

Tip: play three- and four-note minor chords on the off-beat. Raise the Phaser's Mix or the Reverb's Decay for a bigger sound.

preset.description: Two pulse waves whose widths sway in opposite directions on one slow LFO, giving a wide, chorused sound without a chorus. Shared input Sway. A ping-pong echo and a wide hall make the ensemble huge.

help.text:
Two Oscillators in pulse shape, one slightly flat and one sharp. A Sway LFO moves their Pulse Width in opposite directions (one cable is inverted), so the pair slowly breathes in and out of phase. A gentle 1-Pole low-pass softens the top, and the voices spread across the stereo field.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Sway adds to the width movement of both oscillators; turn it up for a deeper effect.

Tip: hold wide, open chords. The motion is slow, so long notes show it best.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay and a wide Reverb widen the ensemble further. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Additive partials whose brightness falls from a bright strike to a mellow hum, with a touch of chorus between the channels: clean, glassy, organ-like keys. An octave shimmer feeds a long hall, so the glassy partials bloom into a halo.

help.text:
An Additive Osc builds the note from up to 40 sine partials on a square-wave base, with a little built-in chorus. A Bright Env lifts the number of partials at the start of each key and lets it settle, so notes strike bright and relax. No filter is involved.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Odd/Even moves the balance between odd and even partials: left is hollow and organ-like, right is fuller.

Tip: play it in the middle of the keyboard with slow chords, then sweep Odd/Even.

A Pitch Shifter adds a quiet octave above, then a long Reverb turns it into a shimmer. Raise the Shifter's Mix for more halo. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A dual oscillator with hard sync that opens wide on each note and settles, the way a classic sync lead rakes across a chord. Shared input Sync. A swirling phaser, a short echo and a room put air around the rake.

help.text:
A Dual Osc with both oscillators set to saw, the second one synced to the first. An envelope raises the Sync amount on every note and lets it fall back, which makes the harmonics sweep from tearing to calm. A ladder takes the harshest edges off.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Sync adds to the sync amount for the whole cell: raise it for a more aggressive sound.

Tip: short staccato chords reveal the sweep best; hold notes to hear it settle.

A slow Phaser sweeps the sync-rake's harmonics, a short Delay adds a bounce and a small Reverb gives it a room. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A sine-like oscillator pushed into a wavefolder that relaxes after every strike: reedy, metallic keys with a barky attack and a smooth sustain. A phaser, a chorus and a small room: the classic electric-piano treatment.

help.text:
A Dual Osc generates a near-sine and folds it with its own Fold control. An envelope drives the fold up at the start of each note and lets it fall, so the strike is bright and barky while the held note mellows. A quick 1-Pole low-pass trims the top.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Fold adds to the fold amount; velocity also increases it.

Tip: play it with short, varied-velocity chords, like an electric piano that bites back.

A Phaser and a Chorus in series give the piano its dreamy, vintage swirl; a small Reverb finishes it. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A saw pair into a Low Pass Gate: notes bloom open and close slowly and darkly, an organic, rounded poly synth. Shared input Brightness. Dotted ping-pong echoes and a big hall make every gated chord trail off into space.

help.text:
Two detuned Oscillators (a saw and a triangle-core pulse) run into a Low Pass Gate. Each key pings the gate, which opens fast and closes slowly and more darkly, like a vactrol. The Gate's Active output frees the voice, so there is no separate amp envelope.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Brightness adds to the gate's brightness: how open the tone is while the gate rings.

Tip: play firmly; harder velocity opens the gate further and leaves a longer tail.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay repeats each chord on dotted eighths and quarters, and a large Reverb carries the tails away. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A swarm built on stacked fifths: every key plays an open, hollow harmony that fills the stereo field, through a gentle low-pass. Shared input Warp. A wide chorus and a large hall turn the stacked fifths into a cathedral of sound.

help.text:
A Swarm in Fifths mode spreads six oscillators over stacked fifths with mild detune, drift and width. A Ladder Tanh low-pass at 3 kHz removes the fizz and a slow-ish envelope opens it.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Warp bends the spacing of the swarm's partials; small amounts add colour, large ones get strange.

Tip: single notes are enough; each one is already a chord. Move up and down in fourths and fifths.

A wide Chorus thickens the stack and a large Reverb sets it in a big room. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: The Vowel bank of a wavetable oscillator, steered across the vowels by an envelope and by how hard you play: talking, choir-like keys. Shared input Vowel. A chorus, a plate-like reverb and a faint echo give the vowel keys a choral glow.

help.text:
A Wavetable Osc on the Vowel bank with a little stereo detune. A Vowel Env moves its X position on each note, and velocity pushes it further, so soft notes stay on one vowel while hard ones travel to another. A soft low-pass sits behind it.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Vowel adds to the table's Y position, which picks a different row of vowels.

Tip: play long chords and vary the velocity of each finger to hear different vowels in one chord.

A Chorus, a medium Reverb and a very light Delay surround the vowels. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A narrow pulse split by a dual band-pass pair into a nasal, woody, clarinet-like tone with a breath of noise at the start. Shared input Spread. Tape warmth, a slap echo and a room put the reed in a smoky club.

help.text:
A narrow-pulse Oscillator passes through a Dual Filter in Parallel routing with both bands set to band-pass, pulled apart by Spread to give a hollow, reedy tone. A little Noise is let in by a very short envelope for the breath at the start of the note.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Spread moves the two bands apart: closer sounds nasal, wider sounds hollow.

Tip: play single lines and slow, close harmonies. Keep the vibrato to the pitch wheel on your keyboard.

A Saturator on its Tape curve warms the reed, a short slap Delay doubles it and a Reverb gives it a room. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A macro oscillator on its harmonic model: the spectrum opens upward as you hold a key, a bright, smooth, singing poly tone. Shared input Tone. A shimmer, a slow phaser and a very long hall let each bloom drift away like a cloud.

help.text:
A Macro Osc on the Harmonic model. A Bloom Env raises its Tone and Shape slowly after the key goes down, so the upper harmonics fade in and the note blooms. Velocity sets how far it opens. Aux is not used.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Tone adds to the spectrum position of every voice.

Tip: hold chords for several seconds to hear the full bloom; short notes stay warm and soft.

A Pitch Shifter adds a quiet octave, a slow Phaser stirs the spectrum and a very long Reverb stretches the tails. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two detuned saws plus a sub square through a thick, lightly resonant ladder with a medium envelope: the all-round fat analog bass. Shared input Cutoff. Tape saturation thickens it and a tight room adds depth without blurring the low end.

help.text:
Two Oscillators (saws, 8 cents apart) and the first one's sub output feed a Ladder Tanh filter at 240 Hz. A medium Filter Env opens it on every note. The cell is mono, with a short glide between overlapping notes.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter; raise it for a brighter, more present bass.

Tip: double a kick drum rhythm with it and keep the notes short or long, not in between.

A Saturator on its Tape curve (blended with the dry sound) adds weight, and a small Reverb keeps the bass in a room. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A triangle-core oscillator that starts a fifth above and snaps down onto the note, with a pulse edge: a springy, slapped electric bass. Shared input Snap. A light chorus and a tight room add width to the slap.

help.text:
An Oscillator in a pulse-leaning shape with its sub output added. A very short Snap Env pushes the pitch up by about seven semitones and lets it fall onto the played note in a few milliseconds, the way a slapped string settles. A 2-pole low-pass keeps the highs in check.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Snap adds to how far the pitch snaps down; turn it up for a bigger pluck, down to zero for a plain bass.

Tip: play short, off-beat notes with strong accents and a ghost note between.

A subtle Chorus widens the stereo image and a short Reverb adds a little space around the pops. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A pulse wave whose width ripples on a quick LFO and a filter that follows the key: a hollow, buzzing bass for synth-pop and electro. Shared input Ripple. A chorus and a filtered echo make the ripples stretch across the stereo field.

help.text:
An Oscillator in pulse shape, with a Ripple LFO moving its Pulse Width at a few hertz, and its sub added underneath. A resonant SVF low-pass follows the keys, and aftertouch brightens it.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Ripple adds to the width movement; more of it gives a more obvious chorus-like motion.

Tip: play straight eighth notes. Keep the Ripple LFO slower than the notes to hear it, faster to hear a buzz.

A Chorus, a Delay with its low cut raised (so the repeats stay clear of the low end) and a small Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A sine that dives an octave into the note and rings long, softly saturated: the boomy, sliding 808-style sub for trap and hip hop. Shared input Dive. Ping-pong echoes and a hall follow each dive, so the falls trail into space.

help.text:
An Oscillator on sine, with the sub added a little. A short Dive Env pushes the pitch up an octave at the start of each note and drops it onto the key. A Ladder Tanh filter with drive rounds the edge. The amp tail is long, and legato notes slide into each other with a longer glide.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Dive adds to the depth of the pitch drop. Turn it down to zero for a plain sub.

Tip: play low notes, one at a time, and link them for slides. The note length decides the groove.

A ping-pong Delay with a high and low cut repeats each fall; a Reverb lets it fade out. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A 25 percent pulse and a triangle an octave down with no filter and a hard stepped envelope: a clean, buzzy video-game console bass. A bright ping-pong echo gives the chiptune notes a bounce.

help.text:
An Oscillator on a narrow pulse and a second on a triangle one octave lower are mixed and sent straight to the VCA with no filter, so the sound stays bright and simple. The envelope is short and drops to a held level quickly.

Notes in, Out L/R. No shared inputs. The cell is mono with no glide.

Tip: play fast, arpeggiated eighth or sixteenth bass lines; combine with a tight drum loop.

A short ping-pong Delay with a raised low cut, and a faint Chorus for width. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A plucked-string model struck on every key and damped by a low-pass: a woody, acoustic double-bass pluck for jazz, folk and bossa lines. A warm room and a little tape put the upright in a studio.

help.text:
A Macro Osc on the Pluck model is struck by Voice In's trigger and rings on its own. A Ladder low-pass at 600 Hz opens a bit with velocity so a hard note has more finger and a soft one is round. The Tone and Decay are set for a short acoustic note.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Brightness opens the low-pass: lower makes it more muffled.

Tip: play walking quarter notes at moderate velocity; leave rests between phrases.

A Reverb with plenty of damping gives a studio room and a gentle Saturator warms the tone. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two oscillators in exponential FM with the modulator following the key: a clangorous, grinding industrial bass that gets meaner the harder you play. Shared input Grind. Diode grit and a slow phaser make the engine growl and swirl.

help.text:
A Dual Osc in Exponential FM mode, the second oscillator modulating the first, with a little fold. A Grind Env raises the FM depth at the start of a note, and velocity adds more. A Ladder Tanh filter tames the highest metal.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Grind adds to the FM depth. Mono, no glide.

Tip: low, repeated notes with different velocities produce the most interesting growls.

A Saturator on its Diode curve adds grit, a slow Phaser swirls the grind and a very small Reverb glues it. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: The Fold bank of a wavetable oscillator, swept by an envelope from smooth towards harsh on each note: a modern, evolving digital bass. Shared input Position. A jet-like flanger sweeps the folded tones and a small hall adds depth.

help.text:
A Wavetable Osc on the Fold bank, an octave down with its sub added. A Table Env sweeps the X position of the table from mellow shapes to folded ones at the start of each note, and then settles. A ladder with moderate drive adds weight.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Position adds to the table's Y axis, so it changes which family of shapes the sweep plays through.

Tip: automate Position over a few bars for a bass that changes character without changing notes.

A Chorus in Flanger mode sweeps through the folded harmonics; a small Reverb finishes it. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A saw through a dual filter whose band spread opens with each note, so the bass says a short, rubbery 'yow' on every hit. Shared input Mouth. A slow phaser adds a talking motion to the mouth bass.

help.text:
An Oscillator saw plus sub go into a Dual Filter in Serial routing, both sides set to band-pass with high resonance. A Mouth Env widens the Spread and lifts the Cutoff at the start of each note, which moves the two peaks like a vowel. Legato notes keep the shape and slide.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Mouth moves the filter's resting cutoff: lower is darker, higher opens up an 'ee'.

Tip: play slow, syncopated notes with some overlap, and push the Mouth dial while a note is held.

A slow Phaser moves the vowels further and a small Reverb gives them room. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A swarm of oscillators spread over three octaves, with the lowest ones leading: a huge, mono-compatible bass for dance floors. Shared input Cutoff. Chorus, tape and a room turn the octaves into a big, wide bass.

help.text:
A Swarm in Octaves mode with six oscillators, a little detune and moderate width, played from a low Octave. A Ladder Tanh filter with keytracking and a snappy envelope closes the top end. The stereo width is kept moderate so the low end stays solid.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter.

Tip: play long root notes under chord changes; cut high-pass on the rest of the mix to leave room.

A Chorus widens the octaves, a Saturator adds weight and a Reverb adds depth. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two slightly detuned saws into a ladder that swells open after the attack, with a late vibrato: a bold, brassy solo line. Shared inputs Cutoff and Bend. A slap echo and a concert hall make the horn swell.

help.text:
Two saw Oscillators, a few cents apart, feed a Ladder Tanh filter at 700 Hz. A Filter Env opens it to several times that after a short swell, the way a horn section blooms, and velocity pushes it further. A Vibrato LFO fades in on held notes. Mono, legato, short glide.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter; Bend bends both saws by up to 2 semitones, so patch a pitch-bend source there.

Tip: play hard for the bright, blaring side of the filter and soft for a mellow one.

A short slap Delay and a hall Reverb place the horn on a stage. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Additive partials rolled off steeply and chorused wide, with a slow vibrato: a pure, ringing, singing-glass lead; pressure adds upper harmonics. Shared input Brightness. An octave shimmer into a long hall gives the glass an angelic halo.

help.text:
An Additive Osc with only a handful of saw partials and a steep Tilt, so the tone is nearly a sine with a halo. Its built-in chorus and width spread it across the stereo field. A slow Vibrato LFO fades in, and channel pressure raises the Tilt to add upper partials. Mono, legato.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Brightness adds to the Tilt, so turning it up brings in more partials.

Tip: play high, slow melodies and lean on the key for the bright, glassy edge.

A Pitch Shifter adds a quiet octave and a long Reverb stretches it into a halo. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A vowel-bank wavetable that scans from one cycle to the next as each note swells, with pressure on the second axis: a vocal, wailing lead. Shared input Scan. Ping-pong echoes and a hall let the siren bounce around the room.

help.text:
A Wavetable Osc on the Vowel bank. An envelope pushes the X position across the table after each note-on, and pressure moves Y. A quiet vibrato is added and a 1-Pole low-pass at 9 kHz tames the top. Mono, legato.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Scan adds to the X position, so a knob or LFO there picks which vowel the lead sits on.

Tip: hold a long note and turn Scan to hear the table change shape underneath you.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay and a hall Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two cores ring-modulated at a tunable interval, falling in from above on every note: a clanging, sci-fi lead with a metallic bite. Shared input Ratio. A trail of echoes and a phaser turn the comet's tail into a long streak.

help.text:
A Dual Osc whose ring-modulated output carries the sound: the product of both cores, a metallic tone whose sidebands depend on the interval between them. A Dive Env drops the pitch by about seven semitones in the first moments of each note. A Ladder Linear low-pass at 4 kHz rounds it off. Mono.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Ratio adds to the tuning of core B, so turning it changes the interval and with it the clang.

Tip: sweep Ratio slowly while you hold a note, or park it where the sound turns bell-like.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay, a Phaser and a Reverb extend the ring-modulated trail. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A bright pulse with a sub that lands on each note from a fifth above in a few milliseconds, with a slowly breathing width: a punchy, squelchy electro lead. Shared input Width. A bouncing echo and a room let each pitch drop ring.

help.text:
A pulse Oscillator plus its own sub, through an SVF low-pass at 3.2 kHz. A very short Drop Env adds seven semitones to the pitch and lets it fall away, so every note lands with a chirp. A slow LFO makes the pulse width breathe. Mono, short glide.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Width adds to the pulse width.

Tip: play staccato, rhythmic lines and move Width for thinner or fatter tones.

A Delay and a small Reverb give the drops some tail. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A pulse-formant oscillator whose resonant peak sweeps up on every note and with pressure, with a hint of vibrato: a wah-like, crying lead with no filter. Shared input Formant. A phaser and a big hall make the cry swirl and carry.

help.text:
A Formant Osc: a resonant peak that moves through the harmonics, vocal and filter-like with no filter in sight. A Formant Env raises the peak after each note-on, and pressure raises it further. A Vibrato LFO fades in. Mono, legato.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Formant adds to the peak position, so a knob or mod wheel there gives you the wah by hand.

Tip: play long notes and ride the pressure for a voice that seems to speak.

A slow Phaser moves through the formants and a large Reverb makes the cry carry. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A modelled string kept sounding by a bow, with a delayed vibrato: a rosiny, expressive solo-string lead that responds to how hard you play. Shared input Bow Pressure. Slow echoes and a long hall let the bowed wire hang in the air.

help.text:
A Modal Voice in string geometry driven by its Bow, with the Bow Timbre in the middle and some damping so the note dies away cleanly. A Vibrato LFO fades in; velocity and the gate drive the bow. An amp envelope shapes the entry and frees the voice. Mono, legato.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Bow Pressure adds to the bow, so more of it gives a rougher, more insistent tone.

Tip: play legato and vary Bow Pressure for the scratch and the singing side of the bow.

A slow ping-pong Delay and a long Reverb extend the bow into a haunting tail. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A phase-warp oscillator whose shape cracks open on the attack and settles to a hollow, nasal tone: a snappy, vocal-edged mono lead. Shared input Warp. A flanger, a short echo and a room make the whip jet across the stereo field.

help.text:
A Macro Osc in Phase Warp mode. A Warp Env pushes Shape up at each note-on and lets it fall to a sustained level, giving a quick whip of harmonics. An SVF filter at 5 kHz smooths the top. Mono, legato.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Warp adds to the Tone macro, which changes the character of the warp itself.

Tip: play staccato to hear the whip on every note, legato for a smoother line.

A Chorus in Flanger mode, a Delay and a Reverb extend the whip. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Each note sounds with its fifth and octave through a driven ladder: one-finger power chords that turn single notes into a stadium-sized rock lead. Shared inputs Cutoff and Drive. A chorus, dotted echoes and a hall make the fifths sound enormous.

help.text:
A Chord Osc set to a fifth with three voices, a little detune and wide stereo, so every key gives root, fifth and octave. They pass through a Ladder Hyperbolic filter at 3 kHz with its Drive turned up. Two voices, legato.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter and Drive adds more grit.

Tip: play simple, strong melodies; the chord is already in the sound.

A Chorus, a tempo-synced dotted-eighth Delay and a Reverb give the lead an arena sound. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two high carriers beat against each other to give an eerie, whistling tone that wobbles in and out of lock: a ghostly, lab-instrument lead. Shared input Beat. Echoes and a faint shimmer let the whistle bend off into space.

help.text:
A Beat Oscillator: two high carriers mixed down to the difference between them, with drift so that the pitch never sits perfectly still and a slow vibrato on top. A Ladder Linear low-pass at 6 kHz smooths the edges. Mono, legato with a glide.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Beat adds to the beat knob, shifting the whistle off its pitch.

Tip: play long, slow phrases and nudge Beat to bring the pitch in and out of focus.

A ping-pong Delay, a faint octave shimmer and a Reverb carry the whistle away. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Additive saw partials with a built-in chorus and a tilt that drifts slowly brighter and darker: a clean, airy pad that rises like first light. Shared input Brightness. A wide chorus and a long hall let the dawn spread over the stereo field.

help.text:
An Additive Osc with 24 saw partials, a soft Tilt and a wide, slow chorus. An Organic LFO moves the Tilt up and down over many seconds, and velocity adds a little more top. A slow amp envelope fades each note in and a long release lets chords melt into one another. Six voices.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Brightness adds to the Tilt.

Tip: hold open chords with the sustain pedal and raise Brightness as the section builds.

A wide Chorus and a long Reverb bring the pad into a hazy distance. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A spectral wavetable that wanders slowly across its grid on two axes, never repeating the same way twice: a glassy, shifting pad. Shared input Drift. A slow phaser turns the tide, and a very long hall carries it away.

help.text:
A Wavetable Osc on the Spectra bank. Two Organic LFOs move X and Y very slowly, and each voice starts from a slightly different place. A gentle 1-Pole low-pass at 6 kHz takes off the digital edge. Six voices.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Drift adds to the X position, so you can steer where the pad sits in the table.

Tip: hold a chord and listen: the sound slowly changes from bright to hollow and back.

A very slow Phaser adds sweeping notches and a very long Reverb stretches the pad into a landscape. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A pulse-formant oscillator whose peak drifts slowly, voice by voice, giving a hummed, hollow choir that never settles on one vowel. Shared input Formant. A wide chorus and a cathedral reverb make the choir sound a hundred strong.

help.text:
A Formant Osc in a wide stereo setting. An Organic LFO nudges the Formant peak a little differently for each voice, so a chord sounds like several singers on slightly different vowels. A 1-Pole low-pass at 4 kHz softens it and a slow envelope swells each note. Six voices.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Formant adds to the peak position and so moves the vowel for all voices together.

Tip: play wide, open chords and ride Formant slowly for a choir that turns its head.

A wide Chorus thickens the voices and a very large Reverb places them in a cathedral. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Every key sounds a full minor seventh chord, slightly detuned and spread wide through a soft ladder: one-finger jazzy pad harmony. Shared input Cutoff. A shimmer, slow echoes and a huge hall give the sevenths a golden glow.

help.text:
A Chord Osc set to a minor seventh with four voices, a little detune and a wide stereo image, through a Ladder Linear filter at 1.4 kHz that a slow envelope opens. Three voices, since each already plays a whole chord.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter.

Tip: play single notes for lush chord changes; play two or three together for stacked, ambiguous harmony.

A Pitch Shifter adds an octave shimmer, a slow ping-pong Delay and a very long Reverb finish the glow. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two detuned saws through a pair of parallel resonant filters whose peaks slowly drift apart and together, like a vowel at dusk. Shared input Spread. A slow phaser and a deep hall let the dusk formants breathe.

help.text:
Two saw Oscillators feed a Dual Filter in Parallel mode with moderate resonance. A slow LFO changes the Spread between the two peaks, so the voice-like colour opens and closes over several seconds. Six voices with a long release.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Spread adds to the distance between the two filters.

Tip: play low chords; the filters follow the keyboard, so the colour moves with the harmony.

A slow Phaser moves the formants and a long Reverb sets them in a big space. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Three detuned pulse waves, each with its own slowly wandering width, into a soft low-pass: a thick, swirling analog ensemble. Shared input Cutoff. A deep chorus, a gentle phaser and a long hall make the ribbons a lush ensemble.

help.text:
Three pulse Oscillators tuned -10, 0 and +10 cents. Two Organic LFO outputs and a random LFO move their pulse widths at different slow rates, so the thickness keeps changing. An SVF low-pass at 2.2 kHz shapes them. Six voices.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter.

Tip: play chords in the middle register and let them sit for a few bars to hear the width move.

A deep Chorus, a gentle Phaser and a long Reverb make the ensemble lush. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: An FM voice an octave up with a gently wandering index and a slow swell: a cold, shimmering pad of glass-bell overtones. Shared input Shine. Shimmer and icy echoes in a big hall: frozen glass, ringing forever.

help.text:
A Macro Osc in FM mode, one octave up. A slow Random LFO changes the Shape (the FM index) per voice and an envelope brightens the swell. A high-cut SVF filter at 7 kHz keeps it from getting harsh. Six voices with a long release.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Shine adds to the index and so to the number of bell-like overtones.

Tip: play high, sparse chords; low notes sound heavier and less glassy.

A Pitch Shifter adds a bright octave, a ping-pong Delay scatters it and a bright, long Reverb freezes it. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Pink noise through a narrow band-pass that tracks each note, with a soft triangle underneath: a breathy, pipe-like pad with air on every chord. Shared input Breath. A chorus and a church-sized reverb put the organ in a nave.

help.text:
Pink Noise goes through a resonant SVF band-pass that follows the key, which makes the noise ring at the note's pitch. A soft triangle Oscillator sits underneath for body. Both go through a VCA with a slow swell. A drifting LFO moves the band slightly. Eight voices.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Breath adds to the level of the noise.

Tip: play octaves or fifths; the narrow band rings clearly on simple intervals.

A Chorus and a large Reverb place the breath organ in a church. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A deep saw, its sub and a veil of brown noise behind a closed low-pass that creeps open as the note holds: a dark, rumbling bed. Shared input Cutoff. Dark, slow echoes and a vast, damped reverb make the fog roll in.

help.text:
A saw Oscillator an octave down with its sub output, plus Brown Noise, all through a Ladder Tanh low-pass at 220 Hz. A slow Filter Env opens the filter during a held note. A random LFO drifts the cutoff a little. Four voices, long release.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Cutoff moves the filter.

Tip: play low, sparse notes and bring Cutoff up for a slow-motion rise.

A slow ping-pong Delay with its high cut lowered and a vast, damped Reverb make a dark, deep fog. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: The Folder's own oscillator, folded a little more and less by slow wandering modulators and pushed off-centre: a rippling, shimmering west-coast pad. Shared input Fold. Shimmer and a drifting phaser in a huge hall make the aurora shimmer.

help.text:
A Wavefolder using its internal oscillator. An Organic LFO moves the fold amount and the symmetry slowly, so the harmonics ripple like a light curtain. A swell envelope also folds the note more as it opens. A 1-Pole low-pass at 5 kHz rounds off the top. Six voices.

Notes in, Out L/R. The shared input Fold adds to the fold amount.

Tip: keep Fold low for a gentle shimmer and raise it for glassier, more metallic textures.

A Pitch Shifter adds an octave shimmer, a slow Phaser drifts and a huge Reverb finishes the aurora. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Additive Osc partials with a steep tilt and a short decay, an octave up: the soft, glassy ping of a celesta; velocity opens the top partials. Shared input Brightness. Ping-pong echoes and a bright hall make the celesta sparkle.

help.text:
An Additive Osc an octave up with a downward spectral tilt and a short built-in decay, so every note is a quick glassy ping that dies away. A small amount of velocity is cabled to Tilt, so harder keys have more upper partials. An amp envelope with a one second release lets the tail fade out.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The Brightness input adds to the Tilt: turn it up for a harder, more metallic celesta, down for a dull felt tone.

Tip: play two-handed octaves in the upper half of the keyboard; the sound is already shifted up.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay and a bright hall Reverb let each note sparkle. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Resonator's String model plucked mid-string with firm damping and a soft low-pass for the body: a warm nylon-string guitar pluck. Shared inputs Brightness and Body. A light chorus, a slap echo and a room put the guitar in a studio.

help.text:
A Resonator in String model, strummed by each note. Its damping is high so the string decays in about a second, and the pluck is in the middle of the string for a round tone. The result goes through a low-pass filter named Body, which acts as the guitar's wooden box.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. Brightness raises the string's brightness, Body opens or closes the filter. Velocity plucks harder and brighter.

Tip: play three- and four-note chords with a little roll between the keys for a strummed feel.

A Chorus, a short slap Delay and a Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Macro Osc's plucked string, picked hard and bright, through a nasal band-pass that stands in for the drum-head: a short, twangy banjo. Shared input Twang. A slapback echo and a small room give the banjo a porch sound.

help.text:
A Macro Osc in Pluck model with a high Tone and a short decay, struck by each note. The signal goes through a band-pass filter named Head, which gives the nasal, tight banjo drum-head sound. Velocity sets the pick accent and nudges the filter up a little.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The Twang input moves the centre frequency of the Head filter: a mod wheel there turns a mellow banjo into a sharp one.

Tip: play fast alternating notes, as in a roll, with a short gate.

A short slap Delay and a small Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two Modal Voices strike metal bars tuned a few cents apart, so every note shimmers with a slow beating: a paired-bar metallophone. Shared input Beating. A shimmering hall and soft echoes let the bars ring on.

help.text:
Two Modal Voices in a bar geometry strike with a medium-hard mallet, tuned slightly apart (about 7 cents up and down), and a small Audio Mixer pans one a little left and the other right. The pair beats slowly, the shimmer typical of paired gamelan bars. Velocity strikes harder.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The Beating input adds fine detune to the second voice (in effect faster or slower shimmer).

Tip: play slow, ringing melodies in the middle of the keyboard and let the notes overlap.

A slow Chorus, a ping-pong Delay and a large Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Modal Voice struck hard as a long bell tube with almost no damping and a wide room: a slow, ringing orchestral chime; velocity brightens the strike. Shared input Ring. A shimmer and an enormous reverb: this chime really fills a cathedral.

help.text:
A Modal Voice with a hard strike on a bell-like body: low damping and a large size give the long, metallic ring of a tubular chime, and the space knob adds a wide room. Velocity strikes harder and raises the strike timbre. The amp release is long, so keys can be released without cutting the ring.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The Ring input adds to the damping (turn it up for a shorter, drier chime, or leave it down for the full ring).

Tip: play single low notes; chords of many bells turn to wash quickly.

A Pitch Shifter adds a faint octave and a very large Reverb lets the chime ring for seconds. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Perc Voice's Modal engine with heavy damping and a hard click: a dry, hollow, pitched wood block that follows the keyboard; velocity is the accent. Shared input Hollowness. Dotted ping-pong echoes and a small room turn single knocks into rhythms.

help.text:
A Perc Voice in Modal engine with a very short decay, strong damping and a hard click. The pitch follows the keyboard, so you can play tuned wood blocks and melodies. Velocity is the accent, and a little Random on Morph makes each hit slightly different.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. Hollowness adds to Tone: low is a thick block, high a thin, hollow tube.

Tip: stick to a pentatonic scale of black keys for an instant tuned-percussion groove.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay and a small Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A pure sine pinged through a fast, resonant Low Pass Gate with a small pitch drop: round, liquid water-drop plinks. Shared inputs Resonance and Drop. Ping-pong echoes and a shimmering hall make every drop ripple outward.

help.text:
An Oscillator sine goes into a Low Pass Gate in the Fast cell setting, in Both mode (filter and level together). Every note pings the gate, which opens in a snap and closes in a short, darkening decay. A short envelope lowers the pitch by a few semitones at the start for the 'plop' of a drop. Velocity sets the ping strength.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. Resonance rings the gate's filter, Drop sets how far the pitch falls at the start of each note.

Tip: play fast random notes high on the keyboard, with a reverb after the cell, for a rain texture.

A tempo-synced ping-pong Delay, a faint octave shimmer and a long Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Two sine oscillators in FM with a quick-fading index and a touch of fold: the bark-then-bell of an electric tine piano; velocity sets how hard it barks. Shared input Bark. A phaser, a chorus and a room make the tines swirl like a vintage electric piano.

help.text:
A Dual Osc with two sines at a 1:1 ratio, B frequency-modulating A. An envelope named Bark controls the FM depth: a strong index at the strike that quickly falls to a clean tone, which is the bark that turns into a bell. Velocity adds to the Bark envelope. A little fold adds harmonics. The amp envelope decays gently while the key is held.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The Bark input adds to the base FM depth for a brighter or softer piano.

Tip: play slow chord voicings in the lower middle range, hard for bark and soft for a mellow tone.

A Phaser, a Chorus and a Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: A bright plucked string excites the Resonator's sympathetic strings, which ring and buzz around the note like the drone strings of a sitar. Shared inputs Buzz and Sympathy. Echoes and a hall let the sympathetic strings ring on in the room.

help.text:
A Macro Osc in Pluck model, bright and hard, plays into a Resonator in Sympathetic model, which adds a cloud of resonating strings that follow the played pitch. Both the pluck and the resonance sound; odd and even partials go to the two sides of the stereo field. Velocity sets the pick accent.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. Sympathy sets how much of the dry pluck feeds the strings, Buzz adds to the Resonator's brightness for a sharper edge.

Tip: play a drone note with your thumb while a melody runs above it.

A ping-pong Delay and a hall Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: Perc Voice's FM engine with a quick pitch sweep and a warm skin: a tuned conga-like hand drum you can play melodies on; velocity is the slap. Shared input Skin. A slap echo and a warm room make the hand drum bloom.

help.text:
A Perc Voice in FM engine with a medium decay, a generous pitch Sweep (the skin tightens as it is hit) and a moderate click. The pitch follows the keyboard, so you can tune the drum to a melody. Velocity is the accent and also adds to the click, so soft is a warm tone and hard is a slap.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The Skin input adds to the Tone and Morph for a brighter, tighter drum head.

Tip: play octaves of two or three notes in a pattern, like a hand drummer, across the low keys.

A short Delay and a warm Reverb. Everything after the voices is inside the cell: open it to change the effects.

preset.description: One recorded piano note played across the keyboard, softened by a touch of chorus and a small room; velocity plays the touch. Shared inputs Brightness and Room.

help.text:
A Sampler holding a single mezzo-forte piano C4, transposed from the Root Note to every key. A very light Chorus widens it and a small Verb adds a room. Velocity raises the level and, a little, the brightness.

Play it from Notes in and take Out L/R. Brightness opens the Sampler's low-pass filter; Room sets how much reverb is mixed in.

Notes far from C4 get the sound of a speeded-up or slowed-down tape: play mostly within an octave or so of middle C for the most natural result.

preset.description: A struck crotale doubled an octave higher in Layers mode and sent through tempo-synced ping-pong echoes: icy, ringing chimes. Shared inputs Echo Mix and Ring.

help.text:
A Sampler plays one fortissimo crotale in Layers mode: every key starts two playheads, the second an octave above and a few milliseconds late, which thickens the strike into a shimmer. A tempo-synced Delay in ping-pong mode and a Verb finish it.

Play it from Notes in. Echo Mix sets the delay level; Ring lengthens or shortens the Sampler's release. The delay follows the cell's Clock input, or the transport when nothing is patched.

Play high, sparse notes and let the echoes answer; low notes turn the crotale into a gong.

preset.description: A recorded Thai gong stacked in three layers a fifth apart, each starting slightly later and swelling in under a long reverb: a slow, bowed-sounding chord from one key. Shared inputs Bloom and Swell.

help.text:
A Sampler in Layers mode with three playheads per key, each a fifth above the one before and 70 ms later, with a soft attack, so a single note blooms into an open stack of fifths. A long Verb carries it away.

Play it from Notes in and take Out L/R. Bloom raises the reverb level; Swell lengthens the Sampler's attack.

Hold low notes and let them overlap; the gong's own beating partials make slow, moving harmonies.

preset.description: One bar of claves, castanets, granite block and hi-hats cut into sixteen slices, one per key from middle C upwards: finger-drum a new bar, or let a sequencer rearrange it. Shared inputs Tone and Crush.

help.text:
A Sampler with Slice Mode on holds the 120 BPM wood loop cut into sixteen equal slices. The key C4 plays the first slice, C#4 the second, and so on up to D#5. Each slice plays to its end, whatever the key length.

Play it from Notes in: a step sequencer or an arpeggiator on a chromatic scale rearranges the bar. Tone closes the Sampler's low-pass filter; Crush adds a lo-fi bit and rate reduction.

Select a slice in the Sampler view to give it its own pitch, level or reverse playback.

preset.description: A small kit of recorded hits (balloon thud, castanet, clave, tambourine, two hi-hats, granite tom, crash) that plays its own shuffle with the transport and answers General MIDI drum keys. Shared input Room.

help.text:
A Drum Grid plays a one-bar groove on eight Samplers: a balloon pop pitched down as the kick, castanets as the snare, a clave as the rim, a tambourine as the clap, closed and open hi-hat hits, a granite block as the tom and a crash. Drum Notes adds the General MIDI keys on top, so you can fill in by hand; the grid's velocity and the key's velocity both set each hit's level.

Start the transport and take Out L/R; patch Notes in from a keyboard or a MIDI drum track to add hits. Room sets how much of the kit goes through a short reverb.

Every slot is a plain Sampler: select one to change its Transpose or Release, or load your own sample.

preset.description: A crash cymbal played backwards: each key starts a rising swell that ends in a sudden stop, with a trailing reverb. Shared inputs Pitch and Brightness.

help.text:
A Sampler plays the crash cymbal at Speed -1, so it runs from the tail to the hit and stops. The filter and a Verb soften the end. Keys transpose the swell as well as change its length: higher notes make it shorter.

Play it from Notes in a moment before a downbeat. Pitch bends the whole swell up or down by an octave (the faster the pitch, the shorter the rise); Brightness opens the filter.

Layer it under a normal crash or a drum hit for the classic build-up.

preset.description: Grains scatter a recorded tam-tam into a slowly breathing pad that follows the keys; the long attack and release hold chords together. Shared inputs Position and Blur.

help.text:
Grains reads a recorded tam-tam instead of listening to an input and plays it as a cloud of overlapping grains. Notes to CV sends the played key into Grains' Pitch input, so the cloud itself changes pitch, and an ADSR on a VCA swells it in and out. Play a single key at a time: it is a mono cloud.

Patch Notes in from a keyboard. Position moves where in the strike the grains read (start of the crash on the left, the long ring on the right); Blur washes the grains into one body.

Try an LFO or a slow envelope on Position for a pad that evolves by itself.

preset.description: Two different recordings of steady rain looped and panned left and right: hold any key for a wide shower that fades in and out, whatever the pitch. Shared inputs Muffle and Level.

help.text:
Two Samplers each loop a different steady-rain recording, one left and one right, with Key Tracking at zero so every key plays the rain at its natural pitch. Attack and Release fade it in and out.

Play it from Notes in and hold a key. Muffle closes both filters, as if the window were shut; Level sets the overall loudness.

Set the Transpose of one Sampler a few semitones away for a heavier or finer rain, or mix it under a pad.

preset.description: A piano note and a crotale an octave above, layered and spread across the stereo field with a wide chorus: a bright, glassy bell for slow melodies. Shared inputs Bell Level and Width.

help.text:
Two Samplers share the same keys: a piano C5 panned slightly left, and a crotale an octave above, panned right and quieter. A wide Chorus and a Verb blend them into one instrument.

Play it from Notes in and take Out L/R. Bell Level brings in more of the crotale; Width raises the chorus mix and its stereo spread.

Play high, slow, wide intervals; the piano attack gives the front, the crotale the shine.

preset.description: Grains pick short drops out of a recording of rain and play them as a pitched, shimmering cloud: play a chord of single keys for a bright, sparkling rainfall. Shared inputs Size and Shimmer.

help.text:
Grains plays a rain recording as thousands of tiny drops. Pitch Quant keeps it to octaves and fifths, so the scattered grains sound like a halo around the note you hold; Notes to CV sets the pitch and an ADSR on a VCA fades it in and out. It plays one note at a time.

Patch Notes in from a keyboard. Size makes the drops longer and smoother or shorter and crackling; Shimmer raises the pitch jitter and the feedback.

Play the notes slowly; low keys give a rumbling downpour, high keys a delicate drizzle.

preset.description: A pulse edge rings a resonance tuned by the note, giving clean, glassy test-bench pings; play it with single notes or a sequencer.

help.text:
A Pulse Generator fires one very short pulse per note and its Ring output rings at the note's pitch as a clean, glassy ping. An amp envelope shapes it, and velocity adds to the pulse amplitude, so harder notes ring brighter and longer.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Damping input adds to the Pulse Generator's ring damping.

Raise Damping for short blips, lower it for sustained, bell-like tones.

preset.description: Wide pulses ring a low, quickly damped resonance for tuned thumps like knuckles on a metal cabinet; play it in the low octaves.

help.text:
A Pulse Generator with wide pulses rings a low, quickly damped resonance tuned by the note, which gives a short tuned thump. Velocity hits harder.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. There are no shared inputs; open the cell to change the pulse width or ring damping.

Play it in the low octaves as a tuned kick or tom, and drive it from a sequencer for patterns.

preset.description: Each note fires a burst of six pulses that ring a high resonance into a wobbling tape loop, for stuttering, chattering pings.

help.text:
Each note makes the Pulse Generator fire a burst of six pulses 28 ms apart. They ring a high resonance into a Zone Delay with 70% feedback, a dark tone and some wobble, so the ping stutters and smears.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Feedback input adds to the Zone Delay's feedback and lengthens the loop.

Send a slow LFO to Feedback to let the repeats bloom and die, but keep single notes short, as the loop can run on.

preset.description: A noise burst kicks a filter held just short of self-oscillation, giving a pure whistling sine at the note that blooms and fades.

help.text:
A short noise burst excites a State Variable filter with its resonance set very high, close to self-oscillation, and the filter tracks the keyboard. The result is a nearly pure sine at the note's pitch that blooms and fades.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Resonance input adds a small amount to the filter resonance and pushes it nearer to oscillation.

Try a slow LFO on Resonance, or play a chord to hear several whistles at once.

preset.description: A single click rings a ladder filter at full resonance: a fat, saturating sine that is struck rather than held; play it with varied velocity.

help.text:
A single click from the Pulse Generator (Ring off) hits a Ladder Tanh filter with its resonance almost fully up, so it rings as a self-oscillating sine that follows the keyboard. The amp envelope keeps the tail short.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. There are no shared inputs; velocity pushes into the filter's drive, so harder notes are fatter and more saturated.

Play with varying velocity to change how fat each snap is.

preset.description: A noise burst runs through a band-pass filter and a tuned comb that feeds back into the filter, ringing and squealing before it settles on the note.

help.text:
A noise burst enters a Band Pass filter. Its output goes to a Zone Delay comb tuned to the note, and the comb feeds back into the filter on a cable at 55%. The loop rings, squeals and settles at the note, and a limiter before the output catches overload.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Loop Amount input adds to the comb's feedback.

Raise Loop Amount carefully for longer, screechier loops, and watch your monitor level.

preset.description: A noise burst in a tuned comb with 95% feedback gives Karplus-Strong style plucks; play it like a string, velocity is the pluck.

help.text:
A noise burst goes into a Zone Delay used as a single tuned comb with 95% feedback, tuned to the note: a Karplus-Strong pluck. Tone is set a little dark, so the string loses highs as it rings. Velocity makes the burst louder.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Brightness input adds to Tone.

Raise Brightness for a bright, steel-like string, lower it for a dull, nylon-like one.

preset.description: A click in a tuned comb with wobble, diffusion and a rough character, so the pitch sags and shimmers like a damaged tape string.

help.text:
A pulse ping goes into a Zone Delay comb with 93% feedback and a rough Character, plus diffusion and wobble. The wobble modulates the delay time, so the pitch sags and shimmers like a damaged tape string.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Wobble input adds to the Zone Delay's wobble.

Push Wobble up for seasick pitch with short notes, or keep it low for a steadier comb.

preset.description: A test oscillator with loop gain just under 100%, kicked by each note, rings like a tuned bench drum; play low notes.

help.text:
A Test Oscillator with its loop gain just below 100% is kicked by each note. It rings as a stable sine that decays and bounces, like a tuned bench drum. The note sets the pitch and velocity shapes the level.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Loop Gain input adds to the oscillator's loop gain, so it rings longer.

Play low notes for kick drums. Raise Loop Gain a little for longer tails, but beyond 100% it turns into a hum.

preset.description: A test oscillator with loop gain over unity warms up and hums while a key is held; hold low chords for an old lab drone.

help.text:
A Test Oscillator with loop gain over 100% and a 50 Hz mains hum is kicked once by each note. It warms up and sustains a sine while the key is held. A small reverb adds space and a limiter sits at the output.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Drift input adds to the oscillator's drift.

Raise Drift for a wandering, unstable pitch, and hold a few low notes for the hum.

preset.description: A noise burst through a very narrow band-pass tuned by the note leaves a single bare, slightly wavering sine; play intervals to hear pure partials.

help.text:
A noise burst goes through a Wave Analyzer set to a very narrow 10 Hz band, tuned by the note. Only one partial survives, so it rings as a bare, slightly wavering sine. The band output goes through the amp envelope.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Gain input adds to the analyzer's gain, which sets how loud the narrow band is.

Play intervals or chords for several pure sines, and raise Gain if the notes are too quiet.

preset.description: A tuned ping feeds a delay network with feedback over 100%, so the room builds up and squeals until the envelope reins it in; play short, low notes.

help.text:
A pinger fires a tuned pulse into a Delay Network in Mesh routing with feedback over 100%. The room builds on itself and squeals, and the amp envelope, with a limiter after it, keeps it under control.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Feedback input adds to the network's feedback.

Play short, low notes and expect a loud, unstable result. Lower Feedback to calm the room.

preset.description: A pulse knocks a modal resonator with a high Structure, giving metallic, inharmonic plate rings at the note; sweep Structure while playing.

help.text:
A short pulse knocks the Resonator in Modal model with a rather high Structure, which gives inharmonic, metallic rings. The note tunes the resonator and velocity makes the tone brighter.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Structure input adds to the Resonator's structure, i.e. how clangorous the plate is.

Sweep Structure while you play to move from a tuned bell to a harsh sheet of metal.

preset.description: Noise pinged through a slow low pass gate into a string resonator gives soft, organic knocks that bloom into a note; velocity opens the gate wider.

help.text:
Noise is pinged through a Low Pass Gate, with its slow vactrol response, into a String-model Resonator tuned by the note. The gate opens and closes softly, so the knock blooms into a tone. Velocity sets how far the gate opens.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. There are no shared inputs; open the cell to change the gate's response or the resonator's damping.

Play soft and hard notes to hear the difference: harder ones open the gate wider.

preset.description: A noise burst pings two resonators a fifth apart that feed each other, for a self-answering two-note ring; play single notes and let them bloom.

help.text:
A noise burst pings two Modal Resonators, Root and Fifth (7 semitones up). Each is also fed back into the other at 45%, so they answer each other and ring sympathetically. Root and Fifth reach the output through separate amps.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Damping input adds to the damping of both resonators.

Raise Damping for a shorter, tighter exchange; lower it for a ring that builds up on repeated notes.

preset.description: A band-passed noise burst scrapes a sympathetic-string resonator, which sings at the note's overtones; play chords for several string sets.

help.text:
A noise burst is filtered by a Band Pass filter (the Scrape) and strikes the Resonator in Sympathetic model, whose strings sing at the overtones of the note. Velocity opens the Scrape filter, so harder notes scrape brighter.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Brightness input adds to the Resonator's brightness.

Raise Brightness for a brighter, more metallic scrape, and play chords to excite several string sets.

preset.description: A pulse ping drives a plate body in a big room through its external input, a thunder-sheet clang that rings at the note.

help.text:
A pulse ping goes into Modal Voice's external input (its own strike is off). The plate body in a big room rings at the note like a thunder sheet. The Modal Voice gate follows the key.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Space input adds to the room size, so the clang gets bigger.

Raise Space for a cavernous sheet, or lower it for a tight, dry clang.

preset.description: A struck bell resonance goes into a feeding-back frequency shifter, so each repeat climbs a few Hz and the ping curls into inharmonic spirals.

help.text:
A pulse pings a Modal Resonator, and its odd and even outputs go into a Frequency Shifter with 78% feedback. Each repeat is shifted up by a few Hz, so the bell curls into inharmonic spirals. A limiter sits before the output.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Shift input adds to the frequency shift amount.

Move Shift for faster or slower spirals, and keep notes short, as the feedback tail is long.

preset.description: A ping into a near-endless reverb whose room holds the hiss and the note, so it blooms and hangs in the air; play single notes and let them ring.

help.text:
A pinged pulse enters a very long reverb (40 second decay, 100% mix, wide) and the room holds onto the hiss and the note. The amp envelope has a long release, so the sound blooms and hangs. A limiter sits at the output.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Decay input adds to the reverb's decay time.

Play single notes and let them ring. Lower Decay if the tail gets in the way of the next note.

preset.description: A pitched ping drops into a slow tape loop with 88% feedback and a lurching wobble; each repeat is duller and slightly flat.

help.text:
A pitched ping goes into a Zone Delay in Tape time mode with 88% feedback, dark Tone and a lot of wobble. Each repeat is duller and slightly out of tune, as in a worn tape loop. A limiter sits at the output.

Patch Notes in and take Out L/R. The shared Feedback input adds to the delay feedback.

Raise Feedback for longer-lasting repeats, or send a slow LFO there for a loop that breathes.

preset.description: Four-on-the-floor house on a Drum Grid: round kick, backbeat clap, off-beat open hats, a busy shaker and a little tape-like glue; two patterns, Groove and Peak.

help.text:
A Drum Grid plays a Punch Kick on every beat, a Punch Clap on beats 2 and 4, Ring Hats (closed 16ths and open off-beats) and a Perc Voice shaker made from a noise bank. Two patterns are stored: Groove for the verse and Peak, which adds clap and shaker fills. The mix goes through a Saturator that glues it together.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. The shared Glue input drives the Saturator harder, so a knob or an envelope there makes the whole kit warmer and fatter.

Tip: switch the Drum Grid to Peak for the last bar of a phrase and back to Groove after.

preset.description: A reggae one-drop on a Drum Grid: kick and rim land together on beat three, hats skank on the off-beats, and the rim and tom ride a tempo-synced echo and a spring-like room. Shared input Echo Feedback.

help.text:
A Drum Grid plays a Ring Kick and Ring Rim together on the third beat (the one-drop), Ring Hats on the off-beats and a Ring Tom for fills. The Kit Mixer sends the rim and the tom into a Zone Delay locked to the transport, followed by a short, dark reverb that comes back into the mix. Patterns are Drop and Steppers, the latter with a kick on every beat.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. The Echo Feedback input is added to the echo's feedback: turn it up for repeats that stack up and wash.

Tip: ride the Echo Feedback input at the end of a bar for a classic dub throw.

preset.description: Half-time trap on a Gate Sequencer: a long sub kick, claps on beat three, rolling ratcheted hats and a coin-flip open hat. Shared inputs Sub Tune and Fill.

help.text:
A two-bar Gate Sequencer plays a Punch Kick with a long decay (the sub), a Punch Clap on the half-time backbeat, a Ring Hats voice whose steps are ratcheted into 2 and 3 fast hits for the rolls, and an open hat that fires by chance. Some steps only play while Fill is held.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. Sub Tune, at half strength, moves the kick's tune up and down; Fill is a gate: while it is high, the extra steps marked as fill-only play too.

Tip: tap Fill in the last beat of every second bar for a busier turnaround.

preset.description: A gentle Brazilian bossa on a Drum Grid: clave, a soft two-note kick, a pulsing shaker, cross-stick and a low surdo, in a small wooden room; patterns Bossa and Samba.

help.text:
A Drum Grid with a Ring Rim playing the clave, a Ring Rim in cross-stick voice, a soft Ring Kick, a Perc Voice shaker (noise bank) and a Perc Voice surdo (modal skin). The Kit Mixer sends a little of everything to a small Room reverb. Patterns: Bossa (the classic clave) and Samba, which is busier and louder.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. Room adds to the reverb's mix: turn it up for a bigger, softer space.

Tip: keep the transport slow, around 120 BPM, and pair the cell with a gentle electric piano.

preset.description: Cold industrial on a two-bar Drum Grid: a hot, short kick, a tight snare, metal clanks and a bent tom, all crushed and compressed. Shared input Grit.

help.text:
A Drum Grid with a Punch Kick (hot drive, short decay), a Punch Snare, a Ring Cymbal tuned and shortened to a clank, and a Ring Tom bent hard for the metal-hit sound. The mix goes through a Crunch (drive and bit reduction) and a Compressor that pumps against the kick.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. The Grit input, at half strength, adds Crunch drive: raise it and the kit turns from hard to broken.

Tip: automate Grit slowly over eight bars and bring the drums in and out of focus.

preset.description: A fast two-step drum and bass kit on a Drum Grid: tight kick, cracking snare with ghost notes, skittering hats and a ride, through a sweepable low-pass. Shared input Filter.

help.text:
A Drum Grid at 1/16 steps plays a Punch Kick on the one and the 'and of three', a Punch Snare on two and four with ghost notes between, Punch Hats and a Punch Cymbal in Ride voice. Patterns: Two-Step and Roller, the second with a busier kick and snare. A Multi Filter low-pass closes down the whole mix.

Run the transport (it sounds right at about 170 BPM) and patch Out L/R. The Filter input pushes the low-pass down from fully open: patch an LFO or a slow envelope to build and release a break.

Tip: use Roller for the second half of a phrase and sweep Filter shut over the final bar.

preset.description: A 12/8 Afro-Cuban groove: a Drum Grid of twelve triplet steps plays the bell pattern, two hand drums, a shaker and a deep kick; patterns Bell A and Bell B.

help.text:
The Drum Grid runs at 1/8 triplets with twelve steps, one bar of four beats in 12/8. A Ring Cowbell plays the standard seven-stroke bell pattern, two Ring Toms stand in for a low and a high hand drum, a Perc Voice shaker plays the pulse and a Ring Kick marks the main beats. Bell B shifts the pattern and adds a clave-like rim.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. The Bell Tone input adds to the cowbell's tone: low is dull and woody, high is sharp and metallic.

Tip: play a slow bass or a drone against it and let the bell hold the groove.

preset.description: Four tuned toms tumble down in cascades over a deep kick and a rattling shaker, with a plate-like reverb: a two-bar tribal pattern. Shared inputs Tuning and Wash.

help.text:
A 32-step Drum Grid plays four Punch Toms (tuned from low to high, bend and noise set for a skin sound), a Ring Kick and a Perc Voice shaker. The toms run down in cascades and answer each other across the two bars. The mix goes through a reverb with a medium decay.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. Tuning adds to the tune of all four toms together (half strength), Wash adds to the reverb mix.

Tip: sweep Tuning up a little over eight bars for a rising tension.

preset.description: Micro-percussion on a Gate Sequencer: tiny clicks, a noise tick and an FM blip, half of them coin flips, scattered through a delay network. Shared inputs Space and Fill.

help.text:
A Gate Sequencer plays three Perc Voices: a modal click, a noise tick and an FM blip, plus a small Punch Kick for the pulse. Many steps are coin flips and some are ratchets, so the pattern keeps changing in detail but stays recognisable. The mix runs into a Delay Net with scattered taps, which turns the clicks into a shimmering garden.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. The Space input adds to the delay's mix; Fill is a gate that plays the fill-only steps while it is high.

Tip: keep Space low for dry clicks, or raise it for an almost ambient wash.

preset.description: A relaxed jazz-trio kit on a Drum Grid of triplets: a skipping ride pattern, foot hats on two and four, a feathered kick and brushed ghost snares, in a warm room.

help.text:
The Drum Grid runs 24 steps of 1/8 triplets, two bars of 4/4. A Punch Cymbal in Ride voice plays the classic skip-beat ride pattern, Ring Hats play the foot on two and four, a soft Ring Kick feathers the beats and a Ring Snare with low snap stands for brushes on ghost notes. A Room reverb is mixed in at a low level. Patterns: Swing and Comping, the second with more snare answers.

Run the transport and patch Out L/R. Room raises the reverb mix; keep it low for a close-miked sound.

Tip: play a walking bass or an upright piano over it at 120 to 160 BPM.

preset.description: A short, squeezed kick that sits in the pocket: a tight thump with the tail clamped off.

help.text:
A Punch Kick tuned to 62 Hz with a 0.3 s decay, run through a Compressor with a fast attack and a high ratio, so the body is squashed and the click stays in front.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity scales the hit before it reaches the compressor.

Tip: lower the Compressor threshold for a flatter, more compact thump.

preset.description: A round, medium-long kick pushed into tape saturation for a soft, glued low end.

help.text:
A Ring Kick at 48 Hz with a 0.9 s decay into a Saturator in its Tape character. The saturation adds harmonics so the kick is audible on small speakers, and rounds the top.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. The Tone input opens the Saturator's tone low-pass.

Tip: raise Drive on the Saturator for a thicker kick, or Sag for a looser, pumpier one.

preset.description: A lo-fi, bit-crushed kick that sounds like a cardboard box hit with a beater.

help.text:
A Punch Kick at 70 Hz with a short decay, run through a Crunch module set to 7 bits with some sample-rate reduction and a low-pass at 4 kHz. The steps in the signal give a papery, boxy tone.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. The Tone input opens the low-pass.

Tip: lower Bits on the Crunch for a more broken sound.

preset.description: A hollow, woody kick from a modal drum body: a muffled boom with a dry knock.

help.text:
A Perc Voice in its Modal engine at 72 Hz with a lot of Damp, a short decay and moderate Click, as if a log were struck with a soft mallet. A second, much quieter high layer adds the knock.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity feeds the accent of both layers.

Tip: raise Tone on the body layer to turn the log into something closer to a tom.

preset.description: A laser-like electro kick: a fast FM pitch dive with a squelchy filtered edge.

help.text:
A Perc Voice in its FM engine at 58 Hz with the Sweep at maximum, so the pitch and the FM index fall in a quick zap, then a resonant Multi Filter that rounds the top.

Patch a trigger into Trig and Out L/R. The Tone input moves the filter cutoff.

Tip: raise the filter Resonance for a more vocal squelch.

preset.description: A soft, muffled kick with no click at all: the felt-beater thud for lo-fi and chill beats.

help.text:
A Ring Kick at 56 Hz with no drive and little tone, then a low-pass at 700 Hz, so only the round thud is left.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity sets the hit; the Tone input opens the filter.

Tip: open Tone a little if the kick vanishes under a bass.

preset.description: Three layers in one hit: a click, a punchy mid and a sub sine, glued with a touch of saturation.

help.text:
Three layers in one mixer: a short, bright Punch Kick click at 90 Hz, a Punch Kick body at 55 Hz, and a Ring Kick sub at 38 Hz. A Saturator on the mix glues them.

One Trig fires all three. Patch a trigger there and take Out L/R. Velocity reaches every layer.

Tip: use the mixer levels to rebalance the stack: click for attack, sub for weight.

preset.description: A kick whose sine is wavefolded into a buzzy, harmonic-rich thud: aggressive and bright.

help.text:
A Punch Kick at 52 Hz into a Folder. The fold adds odd harmonics that follow the pitch drop, so the kick has a buzzy tone as it falls. A low-pass at 6 kHz tames the highest folds.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. The Tone input opens the low-pass.

Tip: change the Folder's Symmetry for an uneven, more even-harmonic buzz.

preset.description: A sampled-break style kick: a short, boxy thump with a rolled-off top and a little grit.

help.text:
A Macro Osc in its Kick model one octave down, a 1-pole low-pass at 3 kHz and a gentle Crunch for dust. It is a boxy, old-record kick for hip-hop and breaks.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity feeds the oscillator's accent. The Tone input opens the low-pass.

Tip: the Macro Osc's Shape knob changes the click; lower it for a duller thud.

preset.description: A natural-sounding kick with a short room around it and a scooped low-mid: a live-room feel.

help.text:
A Punch Kick at 58 Hz, an EQ that scoops the muddy low-mids at 300 Hz and lifts the beater at 4 kHz, then a small, short Reverb at 20 percent mix for the room.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity sets the level.

Tip: raise the Reverb mix for a more distant, bigger-room kick.

preset.description: A tight snare with a sharp rim crack on top: a dry, cutting backbeat for rock and pop.

help.text:
Two layers: a Punch Snare at 230 Hz with a short decay and a Ring Rim 4 dB down that adds the hard wooden crack at the front.

One Trig fires both. Patch a trigger there and take Out L/R. Velocity reaches both layers.

Tip: lower the Rim level in the mixer for a more ordinary snare, or raise it for a rim shot.

preset.description: A soft, hissy snare like a brush dragged over a head: quiet, airy, with almost no attack.

help.text:
A Perc Voice in the Noise Bank engine with a low Click and a slow-ish decay, so the noise swells in instead of snapping, high-passed at 1.2 kHz and rolled off above 9 kHz. A faint Modal head sits under it.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. The Tone input opens the low-pass on the noise.

Tip: play it with low Velocity on every beat for a brushed pulse.

preset.description: A huge snare in a dense room that is cut off abruptly: the big, flat-topped eighties wall.

help.text:
A Punch Snare into a large Reverb at nearly full mix, followed by a Compressor with a very fast attack and release that chops the tail short. The result is a loud snare wash with a hard edge.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity sets the hit strength.

Tip: shorten the Reverb Decay for a tighter gate, lengthen it for a longer wall.

preset.description: A small, high, very tight snare: a bright pop with a quick rattle, good for fast patterns.

help.text:
A Punch Snare tuned up to 340 Hz with a high Tone, very short decay (0.12 s) and plenty of Snappy.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. Velocity scales the hit.

Tip: use it for ghost notes and rolls, where a larger snare would smear.

preset.description: A ring snare ground through a bit crusher and drive: a harsh, digital, broken backbeat.

help.text:
A Ring Snare at 200 Hz into a Crunch module with strong drive, 6 bits and sample-rate reduction. The aliasing adds a rough, metallic bite.

Patch a trigger into Trig and take Out L/R. The Tone input opens the Crunch low-pass.

Tip: raise Bits slightly if it is too harsh for your mix.
